title: 移動式防洪擋板部署
summary: 課程把可拆構件視為包含預警、儲存、運輸、組裝、基礎、密封及抽排的完整系統，逐步估算時程、載重與水量，再以共同原因及演練統計檢查可靠度。比尤德利與科隆提供官方工程背景，全部算例為假設，不作實際啟動水位、錨定配置或產品合格證明。
summaryEn: The course treats removable elements as a system of warning, storage, transport, assembly, foundations, sealing and pumping. It calculates timing, loading and water balance before examining common causes and exercise statistics. Bewdley and Cologne provide official project context. Every example is hypothetical, without prescribing operating triggers, anchorage layouts or product certification.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度固定四個必要且互相獨立的操作階段，將每階段成功率由0.98提高到0.99，完整成功率由0.98⁴=0.92236816變成0.99⁴=0.96059601，增加3.822785個百分點。這不是失敗率只減少一個百分點，也不代表現場一定達到相同改善；改善若來自共用同一道路的備援車輛，獨立假設可能根本不成立。應先辨識預報、通知、調度與閉合的共同原因，再用可追溯演練估計條件機率，另外保留洪水超標、密封及結構性能的失效範圍，避免把操作成功當成全面防洪保證。
workedExample.textEn: Keep four necessary independent operational stages and improve each success probability from 0.98 to 0.99. Complete success increases from 0.98⁴=0.92236816 to 0.99⁴=0.96059601, a gain of 3.822785 percentage points. This is not a reduction of only one percentage point in system failure, nor a promise of the same field improvement. Backup vehicles sharing one road may invalidate independence entirely. First identify common causes across forecasting, alerting, mobilization and closure, then estimate conditional probabilities from traceable exercises. Retain separate failure scopes for flood exceedance, sealing and structural performance so that operational success is never presented as comprehensive protection. Changes in crew composition and available routes also require renewed evidence rather than automatic transfer of old probabilities.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」與「平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification" and "Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預警提前量與時間餘裕」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Warning lead time and float” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。通知、調度、運輸、組裝與檢查皆消耗時間，且降雨可能同時影響道路和人員；正的平均餘裕只能作規劃起點，仍需處理預報誤差與作業時間分布。本例各階段依序不重疊，提前量與工時均是假設值，不是任何城市的動員觸發門檻；未將人員安全截止時間等同於水到板頂。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預警提前量與時間餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival. Alerting, mobilization, transport, assembly and checking all consume time, while weather may affect roads and staff together. Positive average float is a planning starting point that still requires forecast and duration uncertainty. The example has sequential nonoverlapping phases and hypothetical timing, not any city’s mobilization trigger. The safe working deadline is not assumed to occur when water reaches the barrier top. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Warning lead time and float” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預警提前量與時間餘裕」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Warning lead time and float”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。通知、調度、運輸、組裝與檢查皆消耗時間，且降雨可能同時影響道路和人員；正的平均餘裕只能作規劃起點，仍需處理預報誤差與作業時間分布。
knowledge.textEn: A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival. Alerting, mobilization, transport, assembly and checking all consume time, while weather may affect roads and staff together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。
可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。
任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。
optionsEn: Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment.
A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival.
Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process.
quiz.explanation: 可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預警提前量與時間餘裕」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Warning lead time and float” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h. Required time is 6.5 h; float is 1.5 h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h. Required time is 6.5 h; float is 1.5 h.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 板材能承受水壓，就能自動證明立柱底座與地基也完全足夠。
密封條只要算出正的壓縮量，就已證明接觸壓力足夠且完全不漏水。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。
optionsEn: A panel resisting water pressure automatically proves its post base and foundation adequate.
Any positive calculated seal compression proves adequate contact pressure and zero leakage.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預警提前量與時間餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Warning lead time and float” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。以安全截止時間而非單一洪峰預報比較所需時間，清楚保留不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources. Include interrupted routes and faster-rising floods in scenarios, comparing required duration against the safe closure deadline rather than one crest forecast while retaining uncertainty in both quantities. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把一場假設部署畫成時間線，列出安全截止與預報誤差，再加入交通延遲。比較是否仍有完整查驗時間，並說明不能為了表面準時而省略閉合檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a deployment timeline with a safe deadline and forecast uncertainty, then introduce traffic delay. Check whether full inspection time remains and explain why omitting closure verification cannot be used to create apparent on-time completion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。以安全截止時間而非單一洪峰預報比較所需時間，清楚保留不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources. Include interrupted routes and faster-rising floods in scenarios, comparing required duration against the safe closure deadline rather than one crest forecast while retaining uncertainty in both quantities.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把一場假設部署畫成時間線，列出安全截止與預報誤差，再加入交通延遲。比較是否仍有完整查驗時間，並說明不能為了表面準時而省略閉合檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a deployment timeline with a safe deadline and forecast uncertainty, then introduce traffic delay. Check whether full inspection time remains and explain why omitting closure verification cannot be used to create apparent on-time completion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification"?
options: 依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。
optionsEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings.
quiz.explanation: 依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預警提前量與時間餘裕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Warning lead time and float” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration. Using crest time as the deadline may falsely show positive float even though access or safe working conditions are lost earlier. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例各階段依序不重疊，提前量與工時均是假設值，不是任何城市的動員觸發門檻；未將人員安全截止時間等同於水到板頂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The safe working deadline is not assumed to occur when water reaches the barrier top.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證」與「板面水壓與立柱傳力機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification" and "Panel pressure and post load path mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「構件清點與運輸趟次」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Component inventory and transport” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擋板、立柱、螺栓與密封件形成可追溯的組裝系統，運輸容量既受質量也受體積和固定方式限制。清點不只確認總件數，還需匹配區段、方向與介面；一個關鍵專用件缺少就可能中斷閉合，而備品不能任意替換未經驗證的規格。本例只依載重計算整數趟次，假設各件可分配且體積及裝卸已確認不控制；未計司機班時、路程或多車平行調度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「構件清點與運輸趟次」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Panels, posts, fasteners and seals form a traceable assembly system. Transport is constrained by mass, volume and securing arrangements. Inventory must match sections, orientation and interfaces rather than merely total counts. One missing specialist component can prevent closure, and a spare is not interchangeable without verified compatibility with the intended system. The example counts whole trips by payload only, assuming items can be distributed and volume and handling do not govern. Driver hours, travel time and parallel vehicle scheduling are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Component inventory and transport” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總構件質量M=12,000 kg、每趟有效載重C=3500 kg，趟次N=ceil(M/C)=4；不是3.43趟。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume component mass M=12,000 kg and effective payload C=3500 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「構件清點與運輸趟次」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Component inventory and transport”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 擋板、立柱、螺栓與密封件形成可追溯的組裝系統，運輸容量既受質量也受體積和固定方式限制。清點不只確認總件數，還需匹配區段、方向與介面；一個關鍵專用件缺少就可能中斷閉合，而備品不能任意替換未經驗證的規格。
knowledge.textEn: Panels, posts, fasteners and seals form a traceable assembly system. Transport is constrained by mass, volume and securing arrangements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 擋板、立柱、螺栓與密封件形成可追溯的組裝系統，運輸容量既受質量也受體積和固定方式限制。
只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。
板材能承受水壓，就能自動證明立柱底座與地基也完全足夠。
optionsEn: Panels, posts, fasteners and seals form a traceable assembly system.
Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section.
A panel resisting water pressure automatically proves its post base and foundation adequate.
quiz.explanation: 擋板、立柱、螺栓與密封件形成可追溯的組裝系統，運輸容量既受質量也受體積和固定方式限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Panels, posts, fasteners and seals form a traceable assembly system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「構件清點與運輸趟次」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Component inventory and transport” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總構件質量M=12,000 kg、每趟有效載重C=3500 kg，趟次N=ceil(M/C)=4；不是3.43趟。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume component mass M=12,000 kg and effective payload C=3500 kg. Required whole trips N=ceil(M/C)=4, not 3.43 trips. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把構件清單連到區段標識與裝車順序，核對尺寸、載重、固定和現場卸貨空間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link inventory to section identifiers and loading order, checking dimensions, payload, securing and unloading space.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總構件質量M=12,000 kg、每趟有效載重C=3500 kg，趟次N=ceil(M/C)=4；不是3.43趟。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume component mass M=12,000 kg and effective payload C=3500 kg. Required whole trips N=ceil(M/C)=4, not 3.43 trips.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 密封條只要算出正的壓縮量，就已證明接觸壓力足夠且完全不漏水。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總構件質量M=12,000 kg、每趟有效載重C=3500 kg，趟次N=ceil(M/C)=4。
每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。
optionsEn: Any positive calculated seal compression proves adequate contact pressure and zero leakage.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume component mass M=12,000 kg and effective payload C=3500 kg.
Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總構件質量M=12,000 kg、每趟有效載重C=3500 kg，趟次N=ceil(M/C)=4；不是3.43趟。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume component mass M=12,000 kg and effective payload C=3500 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「構件清點與運輸趟次」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Component inventory and transport” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把構件清單連到區段標識與裝車順序，核對尺寸、載重、固定和現場卸貨空間。用實際庫存及備品相容紀錄驗證，演練中記錄最後關鍵件到達時間而非僅平均車趟。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link inventory to section identifiers and loading order, checking dimensions, payload, securing and unloading space. Verify actual stock and spare compatibility and record arrival of the last critical component during exercises rather than relying only on average truck-trip duration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：按區段與組裝順序設計一張裝車清單，再加入一件專用件缺貨情境。說明哪項清點可以在出庫前發現問題，以及整數趟次和現場完成時間的差別。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create a loading manifest by section and assembly order, then remove one specialized item. Identify the dispatch check that detects the shortage and distinguish whole-trip count from the actual time of completed installation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：小數趟次向下取整會遺漏構件，僅按總重量裝車可能讓先用構件最後才到；混用外觀相似但介面不合的零件，則可能在現場造成無法壓緊或閉合的接頭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rounding trips downward leaves components behind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把構件清單連到區段標識與裝車順序，核對尺寸、載重、固定和現場卸貨空間。用實際庫存及備品相容紀錄驗證，演練中記錄最後關鍵件到達時間而非僅平均車趟。
knowledge.textEn: Link inventory to section identifiers and loading order, checking dimensions, payload, securing and unloading space. Verify actual stock and spare compatibility and record arrival of the last critical component during exercises rather than relying only on average truck-trip duration.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 按區段與組裝順序設計一張裝車清單，再加入一件專用件缺貨情境。說明哪項清點可以在出庫前發現問題，以及整數趟次和現場完成時間的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Create a loading manifest by section and assembly order, then remove one specialized item. Identify the dispatch check that detects the shortage and distinguish whole-trip count from the actual time of completed installation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
三十次演練都成功，就能用統計方法證明未來失敗機率恰好為零。
把構件清單連到區段標識與裝車順序，核對尺寸、載重、固定和現場卸貨空間。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Thirty successful exercises statistically prove that future failure probability is exactly zero.
Link inventory to section identifiers and loading order, checking dimensions, payload, securing and unloading space.
quiz.explanation: 把構件清單連到區段標識與裝車順序，核對尺寸、載重、固定和現場卸貨空間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Link inventory to section identifiers and loading order, checking dimensions, payload, securing and unloading space. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「構件清點與運輸趟次」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Component inventory and transport” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 小數趟次向下取整會遺漏構件，僅按總重量裝車可能讓先用構件最後才到；混用外觀相似但介面不合的零件，則可能在現場造成無法壓緊或閉合的接頭。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rounding trips downward leaves components behind. Loading only by total weight may deliver early-use items last, while visually similar but incompatible parts can create joints that cannot close or achieve their specified compression during installation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只依載重計算整數趟次，假設各件可分配且體積及裝卸已確認不控制；未計司機班時、路程或多車平行調度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Driver hours, travel time and parallel vehicle scheduling are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 小數趟次向下取整會遺漏構件，僅按總重量裝車可能讓先用構件最後才到；混用外觀相似但介面不合的零件，則可能在現場造成無法壓緊或閉合的接頭。
knowledge.textEn: Rounding trips downward leaves components behind. Loading only by total weight may deliver early-use items last, while visually similar but incompatible parts can create joints that cannot close or achieve their specified compression during installation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 小數趟次向下取整會遺漏構件，僅按總重量裝車可能讓先用構件最後才到；混用外觀相似但介面不合的零件，則可能在現場造成無法壓緊或閉合的接頭。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
板材能承受水壓，就能自動證明立柱底座與地基也完全足夠。
optionsEn: Rounding trips downward leaves components behind.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A panel resisting water pressure automatically proves its post base and foundation adequate.
quiz.explanation: 小數趟次向下取整會遺漏構件，僅按總重量裝車可能讓先用構件最後才到；混用外觀相似但介面不合的零件，則可能在現場造成無法壓緊或閉合的接頭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rounding trips downward leaves components behind. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 板面水壓與立柱傳力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Panel pressure and post load path mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「板面水壓與立柱傳力」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Panel pressure and post load path” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水壓由板面傳到立柱，再經底座與預設基礎承擔，簡單合力分配只能說明某一傳力假設。每根立柱的分攤寬度取決於跨距和邊界，端柱與轉角不一定相同；水深增加還使作用點和彎矩改變，不能只比較板材厚度或額定高度就跳過錨座與地基。本例為垂直單側靜水、均勻跨距的內柱，分攤寬度等於柱距；合力只是外荷載，並非螺栓拉力或任何現場安裝設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「板面水壓與立柱傳力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water pressure passes from panels through posts and bases into prepared foundations. A simple tributary calculation explains only one load-path assumption. Post width depends on span and boundary conditions, with end and corner posts differing from interior posts. Greater depth also changes lever arm and moment, so panel thickness or rated height cannot replace anchorage and foundation assessment. The example uses one-sided still water and an interior post in equally spaced bays, with tributary width equal to spacing. The resultant is external loading, not bolt tension or a field installation design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Panel pressure and post load path” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³、水深h=1.2 m、柱距s=2 m，單柱分攤F=γwh²s/2=14.1264 kN，底矩Fh/3=5.65056 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γw=9.81 kN/m³, depth h=1.2 m and post spacing s=2 m.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 把內柱分攤寬度套到所有邊界可能錯分荷載，忽略底座力矩又會漏掉錨定需求；單獨測試板材不能證明柱、基礎與止水組合在同一荷載下可靠。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gravity-base sliding scale mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重力式底座與滑動尺度」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gravity-base sliding scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 臨時重力式防洪系統可能依自重、蓄水重量或支撐形成抗力，但底面滲水會降低有效法向力並改變摩擦。地表材質、坡度、泥砂及鋪面接縫也會影響接觸，不能把乾燥平整試驗地面的摩擦係數直接帶到雨中現場；滑動計算需和傾覆、承載及滲流並列。本例是單一假設底座的庫侖摩擦尺度，向下重量尚未扣揚壓，無錨定與被動土抗力；比值不是任何產品額定值或安裝許可。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重力式底座與滑動尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temporary gravity systems may resist through self-weight, contained water or bracing, but under-base seepage reduces effective normal force and friction. Surface material, slope, silt and paving joints affect contact, so a coefficient from a dry level test surface cannot automatically represent a wet site. Sliding belongs alongside overturning, bearing and seepage assessment. This is a Coulomb-friction scale for one hypothetical base. Gross weight excludes uplift deduction and no anchors or passive soil resistance are credited; the ratio is neither a product rating nor installation approval. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gravity-base sliding scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設向下W=30 kN、揚壓U=5 kN、μ=0.40、水平力H=8 kN，摩擦R=μ(W−U)=10 kN，R/H=1.25。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加自重一定能解決所有臨時防洪系統的滑動、滲水與承載問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Added weight necessarily solves every sliding, seepage and bearing problem of a temporary barrier." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重力式底座與滑動尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.titleEn: Gravity-base sliding scale mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 臨時重力式防洪系統可能依自重、蓄水重量或支撐形成抗力，但底面滲水會降低有效法向力並改變摩擦。地表材質、坡度、泥砂及鋪面接縫也會影響接觸，不能把乾燥平整試驗地面的摩擦係數直接帶到雨中現場；滑動計算需和傾覆、承載及滲流並列。
knowledge.textEn: Temporary gravity systems may resist through self-weight, contained water or bracing, but under-base seepage reduces effective normal force and friction. Surface material, slope, silt and paving joints affect contact, so a coefficient from a dry level test surface cannot automatically represent a wet site.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加自重一定能解決所有臨時防洪系統的滑動、滲水與承載問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Added weight necessarily solves every sliding, seepage and bearing problem of a temporary barrier. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gravity-base sliding scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設向下W=30 kN、揚壓U=5 kN、μ=0.40、水平力H=8 kN，摩擦R=μ(W−U)=10 kN，R/H=1.25。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross downward W=30 kN, uplift U=5 kN, friction μ=0.40 and horizontal H=8 kN. R=μ(W−U)=10 kN; R/H=1.25. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認摩擦資料與實際濕潤、污染和表面條件相容，追蹤揚壓是否已在重量定義中扣除。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check friction evidence against actual wetness, contamination and surface condition and track whether uplift has already been deducted in weight.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重力式底座與滑動尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gravity-base sliding scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認摩擦資料與實際濕潤、污染和表面條件相容，追蹤揚壓是否已在重量定義中扣除。對排水堵塞、表面沖刷及不平整重新評估，並核對整個經測試系統而不是僅一個底座比值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check friction evidence against actual wetness, contamination and surface condition and track whether uplift has already been deducted in weight. Reassess blocked drainage, surface erosion and unevenness, checking the tested complete system rather than relying on one isolated base resistance ratio. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用兩種假設揚壓比較有效法向力和滑動比，再列出未檢查的失效模式。說明為何改變底座重量或表面配置，需要重新核對完整系統的證明資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare effective normal load and sliding ratio at two hypothetical uplifts, listing unchecked failure modes. Explain why changing base weight or surface preparation requires renewed review of evidence for the complete system configuration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略泥砂潤滑可能高估摩擦，將乾地試驗係數當成固定材料常數也會失真；只為增加自重而疊放未經核對的重物，還可能改變基礎承載和構件受力方式。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting lubricating silt can overstate friction, and treating a dry-test coefficient as a universal material constant is misleading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重力式底座與滑動尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gravity-base sliding scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略泥砂潤滑可能高估摩擦，將乾地試驗係數當成固定材料常數也會失真；只為增加自重而疊放未經核對的重物，還可能改變基礎承載和構件受力方式。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting lubricating silt can overstate friction, and treating a dry-test coefficient as a universal material constant is misleading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 密封壓縮與幾何公差機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seal compression and geometric tolerance mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密封壓縮與幾何公差」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seal compression and geometric tolerance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接頭密封需要適當壓縮和連續接觸，板面變形、地面不平與裝配誤差會消耗幾何餘量。壓縮量可以從厚度和間隙求得，但接觸壓力取決於材料曲線、溫度、老化與壓縮歷程；只看到正壓縮不能保證水密，也不能任意增加鎖緊量而忽略構件和密封件的限制。本例僅計算均勻密封條的幾何壓縮率，未指定材料本構或可用範圍；不得由此推定接觸壓力、鎖緊力或水密等級。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密封壓縮與幾何公差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Thickness and gap give compression, but contact pressure depends on material curves, temperature, aging and loading history. Positive compression does not prove watertightness, and additional tightening cannot ignore component or seal limits and verified installation procedures. The example computes geometric compression of a uniform seal only, without constitutive behavior or an acceptable range. It cannot establish contact pressure, tightening force or a watertightness rating. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seal compression and geometric tolerance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「端部接續與最低高程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “End tie-ins and minimum elevation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿整條防線實測端點、門洞與局部低點，確認與水位使用同一基準。逐段查驗接續和地下穿越，將幾何餘量、波浪預留及其他失效模式分列，不以一張平均高度表代替現場閉合確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey ends, openings and local lows along the complete line using the same datum as water stage. Verify transitions and buried crossings segment by segment, separating geometric margin, wave allowance and other failure modes instead of substituting an average-height table for physical closure confirmation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出一條包含路口、建築和端部高地的防線，找最低有效高程並加上未封閉管線。分別說明越頂、繞流和地下回流，為每一種安排不同的閉合證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a line crossing roads, buildings and high ground, identify the lowest effective elevation and add an open service pipe. Distinguish overtopping, outflanking and underground backflow and assign different closure evidence to each pathway.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看最高擋板會漏掉端部低地，跨越道路或建築接點未密合也可能形成繞流；基準混用則讓表面上正的餘量消失，與板材本身的強度高低無關。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking the tallest panel misses low ground at an end. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「端部接續與最低高程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “End tie-ins and minimum elevation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看最高擋板會漏掉端部低地，跨越道路或建築接點未密合也可能形成繞流；基準混用則讓表面上正的餘量消失，與板材本身的強度高低無關。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking the tallest panel misses low ground at an end. Unsealed road or building transitions create bypass paths, and mixed elevation datums can erase an apparently positive margin regardless of the structural strength of the panels themselves. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只比較三個已確認連續接合點的幾何高程，不含波浪、沉陷或模型誤差預留；正餘量不代表結構、滲流和營運全部通過。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Positive margin does not establish structural, seepage and operational acceptance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閉合流程可靠度機理與驗證」與「演練證據與失敗率界限機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Closure-process reliability mechanism and verification" and "Exercise evidence and failure-rate bounds mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閉合流程可靠度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Closure-process reliability mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「閉合流程可靠度」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure-process reliability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完整部署依賴預報、通知、到場、組裝與查驗等多個必要環節，一個環節失敗就可能無法及時閉合。獨立串聯系統的成功率是各階段成功率相乘，但真實洪水可能同時影響電力、道路和人員，產生共同原因失效；乘積只能在獨立假設下使用，且成功部署還不等於洪水期間結構永不失效。本例只設四個必要且相互獨立的操作環節，各成功率為指定假設；未包含共同原因或洪水荷載超標，不是任何城市的實測可靠度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閉合流程可靠度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Timely closure depends on several necessary stages such as forecast, alert, arrival, assembly and inspection. Failure of one can prevent completion. Independent series success is the product of stage probabilities, but a flood can jointly affect power, roads and staff. Multiplication therefore requires independence, and successful deployment remains distinct from structural survival throughout the event. The example specifies four necessary independent operational stages with assumed success rates. Common causes and load exceedance are excluded; this is not measured reliability for any city. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closure-process reliability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設四個獨立必要環節成功率皆p=0.98，完整操作成功率P=p⁴=0.92236816，即92.2368%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume four independent necessary stages, each with success probability p=0.98.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「四個必要環節各有百分之九十八成功率，整個流程就必定也是百分之九十八。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Four necessary stages each succeeding ninety-eight percent make the entire process ninety-eight percent reliable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閉合流程可靠度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Closure-process reliability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 閉合流程可靠度機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 完整部署依賴預報、通知、到場、組裝與查驗等多個必要環節，一個環節失敗就可能無法及時閉合。獨立串聯系統的成功率是各階段成功率相乘，但真實洪水可能同時影響電力、道路和人員，產生共同原因失效；乘積只能在獨立假設下使用，且成功部署還不等於洪水期間結構永不失效。
knowledge.textEn: Timely closure depends on several necessary stages such as forecast, alert, arrival, assembly and inspection. Failure of one can prevent completion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：四個必要環節各有百分之九十八成功率，整個流程就必定也是百分之九十八。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Four necessary stages each succeeding ninety-eight percent make the entire process ninety-eight percent reliable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closure-process reliability mechanism and verification" is correct?

steps.title: 閉合流程可靠度機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closure-process reliability mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閉合流程可靠度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closure-process reliability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設四個獨立必要環節成功率皆p=0.98，完整操作成功率P=p⁴=0.92236816，即92.2368%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume four independent necessary stages, each with success probability p=0.98. Complete operational success P=p⁴=0.92236816, or 92.2368%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明列成功事件與條件機率的定義，檢查是否由同一電源、道路或人員造成相關性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define success events and conditional probabilities and inspect shared power, routes and staff for dependence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
